title: Interview Atlas - a web forum centered around job interview questions with semantic similarity features
summary: A full stack web forum application built using React and Node,js. The application features, admin moderation, user authentication, question aggregation by company and a semantic similarity features implemented using pgvector in PostgreSQL used for finding related questions aswell as to help prevent duplicate question submission.This project is not deployed but a demo video of the application can be found in the access link above and the source code is available on GitHub.
content: This project was done as part of my final year project at the University of Leicester. Interview Atlas is a focused forum-style platform for candidates and mentors to share, discuss, and prepare for real interview questions. Built with a JavaScript/Express backend, PostgreSQL with pgvector-powered semantic search, and a React frontend styled with Material UI, it offers responsive navigation, user authentication via Firebase, and admin workflows for approving, editing, and managing company-specific questions. Users can submit and explore questions filtered by company, role, difficulty, tags, and date, with support for markdown answers, code snippets, voting, commenting, and related-question recommendations powered by dense vector similarity and full-text search. This project is not deployed but a demo video of the application can be found in the access link above and the source code is available on GitHub.

title: Elixir Quest - a platformer game built in Unity
summary: A simple adventure game built in Unity. Downloadable as a ZIP.
content: Elixir Quest is a small adventure game I built in Unity. In the game you climb ladders, collect powerups and at them to your inventory to help you defeat enemies. This page provides a direct download of the game as a ZIP archive. Unzip, then run the executable file within the folder to run the game.

title: BiteBuilder - A recipe creation app built on Google Gemini's API
summary: A simple web application that lets users input ingredients in their fridge and generates recipes using those ingredients. Currently deployed via Firebase.
content: This was a web application built as part of a group project for my Computational Creativity module at university. The application takes the ingredients, desired cooking time, dietary requriements and type of meal that the user inputs and uses them as additional context for the prompt to Gemini's API. The app then generates 3 recipes which can be expanded or saved for later. The appLication used Firebase for user authetication and Firestore for database actions.

title: Android Shopping List App
summary: A very simple Android app for managing shopping lists. Android Studio ZIP file.
content: This was a simple android app I built as part of a university project that enables a user to create and manage shopping lists. Users can select a cover image, type in the item they need, select a quanity and choose a unit of measurement
